title: Canonical commutative coefficient transport and unit for constant modules
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. Let $\underline\Lambda_{\mathrm{Ring}}$ be its constant ring sheaf and let $\underline\Lambda_{\mathrm{Comm}}$ be its constant commutative ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Write $U(\underline\Lambda_{\mathrm{Comm}})$ for the underlying ring sheaf. Define $c_\Lambda:\underline\Lambda_{\mathrm{Ring}}\xrightarrow{\sim}U(\underline\Lambda_{\mathrm{Comm}})$ to be the canonical sheafification comparison for the forgetful functor from commutative rings to rings. For a $\Lambda$-module $M$, let $F(M)$ be its constant module sheaf [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor]. Define $F_{\mathrm{Comm}}(M)$ by restriction of scalars along $c_\Lambda^{-1}$: it has the same underlying abelian sheaf as $F(M)$ and scalar action $a\cdot m=c_{\Lambda,V}^{-1}(a)m$ on every object $V$. On a linear map use the original constant-module morphism. This is a functor to sheaves of $U(\underline\Lambda_{\mathrm{Comm}})$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define its constant-section unit $\eta_M:(V\mapsto M)\to F_{\mathrm{Comm}}(M)$ on underlying abelian presheaves to be the sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant abelian presheaf, retained under this coefficient transport.
